name: skills
readme_excerpt: Skills For Designers and Engineers For designers and engineers to help them build better user interfaces. Knowing whether you made a right choice when it comes to animations, or design in general, is hard. These skills aim to help you get to those right decisions faster. They are based on my years of experience working at companies like Vercel and Linear. All the skills here are a side-effect of domain-expertise.
